title: Pokemon TCG Luxray Paldea Evolved 071/193 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokemon Company Luxray Holo Rare SV02 071/193 150 HP Stage 2 card is a highly sought-after collectible card from the Pokemon TCG franchise. Featuring the character Luxray with 150 HP in its Stage 2 form, this English language card is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. The holo finish and rare rarity make it a standout piece for fans of the Pokemon series, and its inclusion in the Sv02: Paldea Evolved set further enhances its appeal to enthusiasts of the game.
